# ChatGPT Web Provider

OpenAI-compatible local HTTP provider backed by a user-authenticated ChatGPT Web browser session.

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:17842/v1
Authentication: Bearer token from the private provider config.

Endpoints:
- GET /v1/models
- POST /v1/responses
- POST /v1/chat/completions
- GET /healthz
- GET /readyz

Capabilities: text, image input, JSON responses, SSE streaming.
Not supported: generic tools, embeddings, audio, fine-tuning, non-loopback binding.

Use X-Idempotency-Key for safe retries and X-ChatGPT-Web-Conversation-ID for retained sequential browser context.
